Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Packed snow rolls ahead of your hand, laying a firm white road over mud and broken stone.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Up to eight connected supported ground squares within 6 squares; self and one willing ally within 3 squares.
Type
Magic / Movement / Utility

Lay a ribbon of up to eight connected supported ground squares within 6 squares. Entering these squares costs 1 movement, replacing difficult-ground costs, until the end of your next turn. You and one willing ally within 3 squares may each move up to 3 squares along the ribbon without provoking.
